intro: Three distinctions anchor this issue: mean reward versus the probability of an optimal response, local slopes versus asymptotic power laws, and absolute performance under attack versus the extra degradation due to attack. Briefs include new work by Wharton authors; the classic dissects D3PM transition kernels.
